title: Calibrate an H3-native EasyCache policy
description: Implement and validate a cache policy designed for MiniMax H3's joint video/stereo-audio transformer rather than copying Wan/Hunyuan thresholds. Begin with native 20/30-step Base FL2VA; gate Ref2VA separately; keep Turbo 4/8 disabled unless evidence shows meaningful safe skips.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-seed SDPA baselines and cache variants measure call reduction, wall time, VRAM, video fidelity, motion/flicker, stereo-audio quality/sync, and Ref2VA adherence; identity/reset covers checkpoint, LoRAs, attention, references, schedules, and handoffs; expose only combinations that pass.

title: Evaluate SageAttention3 for H3 after SageAttention2++
description: Evaluate the official Blackwell FP4 SageAttention3 implementation only after SageAttention2++ is validated. Treat it as a separate experimental engine because upstream does not validate MiniMax H3 and recommends hybrid layer/timestep use for unvalidated video models.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned official source builds on the supported Python/Torch/CUDA lane; fixed-seed native and Turbo FL2VA plus Ref2VA compare against SDPA and SageAttention2++ for speed, memory, visual quality, motion/flicker, reference adherence, and stereo-audio quality/sync; no default exposure until all relevant gates pass.

title: Close output-share revision TOCTOU during media serving
description: Output-share capability resolution validates a media pathname revision, then the response path reopens that pathname. A concurrent replace between validation and open can let an old capability stream new bytes. Preserve revocable single-revision semantics by validating and serving from the same opened handle, or by holding the lineage mutation guard through handle acquisition.
acceptance_criteria: A replacement race cannot make a valid old output-share token serve bytes from a newer revision; validation and serving share the same file identity/handle or equivalent lock; stale/revoked/not-found responses remain non-oracular; a deterministic replacement-race regression test passes.

title: Add H3 audio true-peak safety without flattening dynamics
description: Live H3 benchmark on RTX 5090 found valid audio streams but PinkCherry Turbo8 and Base Turbo8 Sage measured about +3.1 to +3.2 dBFS reconstructed true peak (EBU R128), while native ranged much lower. Add an H3-only or output-audio safety stage that prevents clipping/intersample overs without blindly boosting quiet outputs or flattening dynamics. Expose/status the applied policy, preserve audio duration/sync, and add synthetic + live validation across Base/Pink/W4A8/Ref2VA/Turbo/Sage. Acceptance: <= -1 dBTP, no duration drift, no audible pumping in representative clips, user-overridable if appropriate.

title: Make Chat upload cleanup transport-acknowledged
description: Chat marks one-use uploads submitted before transport/server acknowledgement. A network or pre-admission authorization failure can leave private files until the 24-hour TTL. Add a server claim/ack handshake so the client can promptly clean unclaimed uploads without racing an admitted shielded request.

title: Remove presentation-only can_access_output authorization shim
description: Private is presentation-only and project access is the authorization boundary. can_access_output() is now an always-true compatibility shim, but many call sites/tests still look like authorization checks. Remove or rename the shim and update callers/tests so future routes cannot mistake it for a security boundary.

title: Preserve structured post-decode failure diagnostics
description: Replace the generic likely-VRAM failure after H3 decode/concat/postprocess with path-free structured stage/type/OOM diagnostics. Keep raw traceback machine-local; distinguish VAE decode, segment checkpoint, concat, audio mux, delivery, and publication. Never inspect or persist prompt/media content.
acceptance_criteria: Model-free injected VAE/concat/ffmpeg/OOM/non-OOM failures expose correct safe stage/code, only confident OOMs show VRAM guidance, UI card renders useful detail, and no raw path/prompt/stderr leaks.
close_reason: Structured post-decode diagnostics are implemented, live-reproduced, fully tested, and independently approved.
